findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The shelf for storing milk in the walk-in cooler was observed to have soil accumulation from milk deposit. The person-in-charge (PIC) was informed. Ensure the milk shelf is cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Soil accumulation from milk deposit was observed on the floor area under the shelf for storing milk in the walk-in cooler. The PIC was informed. Ensure the floor area under the milk shelf is regularly cleaned and kept free of milk deposit.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Ceiling air exchange vent covers in the mop closet and restrooms were soiled with dust accumulation. Clean the vent covers in the mop closet and restrooms as needed eliminate buildup.
-Lower wall behind vacuum and shred bins beneath alcohol shelf in the storage room was damaged along the top of the baseboard. Store manager will place a work order today for repairs. 
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Floor along back wall was soiled with general buildup in the walkin section of the cooler. Cleaning of walkin cooler was discussed including frequency for changing of milk pads placed under reach-in section shelving.
--Ceiling vent cover in the mop closet was soiled with dust accumulation. Clean the vent cover in the mop closet as needed to eliminate buildup.
--Lower wall in back storage under alcohol storage was observed to be damaged. Some general debris accumulation was also observed on the floor in this area. Cleaning and repairs were discussed.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 The wood pallet used to hold ice off the floor is observed to be constructed of bare wood. Properly seal the bare wood so that moisture and spills are not absorbed into the wood. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Some bags of ice are on the floor next to the pallet they are intended to be stored on in the walk in freezer. 750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.
